text:
maria_cs: Morning async — Borealis Health renewal + webhook delivery flare. Quick standup:

maria_cs: What I did:
- Ran remediation runbook for failed webhooks (hook-id 0x4f2).
- Updated renewal notes and added mitigation steps.
- Opened canary for backoff/retry changes.

maria_cs: Blockers:
- Still seeing intermittent 502s for webhook deliveries in eu-west. Retries are queuing and spiking our consumer pool.
- Need a quick eng CR review for exponential backoff and socket timeout increase: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/pull/421

maria_cs: Today: monitor canary, prep renewal call notes (2pm), coordinate fallback if canary shows regression.

andrew_se: I can reproduce the 502 locally, looks like upstream nginx is resetting sockets under retry surge. Will review #421 now, aiming EOD review. :eyes:

lina_cs: FYI I told the customer we might toggle routing if issues persist. Renewal meeting is at 14:00 UTC — would be ideal to have a mitigation to show.

raj_ops: digging into infra logs — autoscale spike at 11:12 UTC coincident with retry storm. Increasing consumer queue length + bumping socket timeout on proxy to 30s for canary.

raj_ops: logs snippet:
```
2026-04-07T11:12:03Z webhook-proxy: error connecting to eu.svc: upstream reset
2026-04-07T11:12:04Z webhook-proxy: retry attempt=2 hook=0x4f2 status=502
```

andrew_se: small patch in #421 to add jitter + cap retries to 4, also extending connection timeout. If QA passes I'll merge to canary.

sophie_pm: Added a short slide to the renewal deck describing mitigation plan and fallback (routing -> dedicated-eu).

tim_oncall: If we need immediate fallback I can flip routing to dedicated-eu-fallback, but need an explicit ok from CS/product. It will cause short-lived increased latency.

maria_cs: OK to flip if canary fails. @andrew_se please call out any red flags. Lina — I'll mention the fallback in the 2pm call and request permission to execute.

andrew_se: merged PR into canary (commit abc123). Starting verification.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started for service webhook-proxy at 3023457000 — status: in-progress

maria_cs: Thanks team. Today I will: 1) watch canary health dashboards, 2) finalize renewal notes, 3) coordinate exec handoff if toggle needed. Ping here for quick approvals. :thumbsup:
